title: Memoria
overview: Memoria follows the story of Richard Howlett, an older man who lives in his secluded forest, separated from the rest of the bustling world. His lonely home is filled with the sounds of nature, the strong river currents, the leaves rustling in the wind, the birds singing in the morning, but the home has a vast emptiness despite the loud ambience. We see Richard reminisce on his old home, the way things were, how they used to be, as he takes his first steps in learning how to remember and respect the past, while learning how to embrace the future.
